title: DuckCodes
body:
# 🦆 **DuckCodes** – The Ultimate Reward Code Solution!
Take your player engagement to the next level with DuckCodes! This lightweight yet powerful plugin allows you to instantly create custom promotional codes, rewards, and bonuses for your Minecraft community.

# Why choose DuckCodes?
Forget about complex configurations or restarting your server for every change. With the intuitive /adminkod set command, you can create new codes in seconds directly from the game. Whether you want to grant a VIP rank, distribute virtual currency, or simply gift some starter items, the possibilities are endless! The plugin automatically executes your predefined commands through the console, ensuring total security and control over permissions.

# Key Features:

Dynamic Creation: Add codes "on the fly" without ever leaving the server.

Full Customization: Every message and prefix can be edited in the config.yml file to match your server’s unique branding.

Smart Placeholders: Use the %player% variable to automatically target the user who activates the code.

Instant Reload: Update your settings and messages instantly with the /adminkod reload command.

# Performance & Simplicity:
DuckCodes is optimized for the latest Paper and Spigot versions (1.21+). The minimalist code ensures zero impact on server performance, while the professional message formatting makes your server look polished and high-end.

Give back to your community with style – choose DuckCodes!
